counter_contract.lift_success: Every observed phase in [0.52,0.60) has egg height >= initial height + 0.05 m and nonzero (>1e-12 N) contacts with both finger links, counted at crossing 0.60.
counter_contract.descent: Height decreases by more than 0.001 m over one dt=0.01 step in the named controller window.
counter_contract.tail: Per-environment recorded fit evaluations, sample counts, integration retries and elastic work. These are parallel work proxies, not individual GPU wall times.
counter_contract.timing: Both device collection kernels and the public position getter are inside each rollout step. Boundary exports are outside repeat timing.

rollout_work.evaluation_interpretation: The body-union leader carries cumulative dual evaluations. Inactive member constraints retain zero evaluations; only wrench errors/status propagate to members. The sum counts evaluations, not independent solves or GPU time.
rollout_work.contact_fraction_interpretation: Any valid stress-contact witness, including a valid zero-force witness. Nonzero rigid contacts use the separately recorded threshold.
